about: Every mistake becomes a check (PROTOCOL.md Article 3.5, GUIDE.md THE SELF-IMPROVING LOOP). A row is added only together with the gate it names (a gate in Library/OS/CHECK.mjs) and the test it names (a test("...") in Library/OS/CHECK.test.mjs). The errata gate fails a row whose gate is not implemented, whose test is missing, or whose gate does not pass. Founder words in `source`, and the GUIDE.md wording in `error` and `rule` of rows E-001 to E-003, are verbatim. A row whose rule was replaced keeps its first wording and says what replaced it in `superseded`. A row with "edition_change" names the edition before and after a change and the commit before it (PROTOCOL.md Article 6.5): a Page whose blob is unchanged since that commit keeps the old edition line, and the Foyer counter stays at "foyer_version_frozen".

rows.error: An outside review audited a folder named 7.2 whose origin was the frozen glumira-7.1 repo, and the fixes landed in the wrong repo.
rows.root_cause: A folder name was trusted as proof of the repo.
rows.source: .githooks/check-gates.mjs header: "2026-10-05: an outside review audited D:\glumira-7.2, a folder named 7.2 whose origin is the frozen glumira-7.1 repo, and the fixes landed in the wrong repo."
rows.proof: repo-confirm: an origin that is another repo fails

rows.error: A 7.2 session was handed the task list of the frozen glumira-7.1 repo.
rows.root_cause: The boot card named one task list for every repo.
rows.source: Founder, verbatim: "why did you load 7.1 punchlist if we work in 7.2"
rows.proof: no-71-source: a pointer to the glumira-7.1 task list fails

rows.error: Task lists exist in more than one place: the ROADMAP, the build plan, and the Outstanding section of every handover.
rows.root_cause: Nothing counted queue files.
rows.source: ROADMAP.md line 19: "Priority lives here and nowhere else."
rows.proof: single-queue: two queue files fail

rows.error: A second subject-to-Vault table (a JEV-MAP file) was proposed beside the Foyer routes.
rows.root_cause: A derived copy of the authority drifts from it.
rows.source: Founder, verbatim: "The file is now the authority."
rows.proof: single-routing-source: any third routing table fails
rows.superseded: 2026-10-07. PROTOCOL.md Article 3.3, verbatim: "Keep the JEV map as the routing authority. FOYER.json is a generated view, tied to the same revision." Founder, verbatim: "Start the filing build" and "Fix approved". JEV-MAP.json is now the one authority, the Foyer its generated view; the root cause above (a derived copy drifts) is why the two revisions must match.

rows.error: Nothing compared the Foyer with the files under Vaults, so a Page could be filed that the Foyer did not name, or a Foyer line could outlive its file.
rows.root_cause: The Foyer is a hand-kept file and had no reader.
rows.source: Founder, verbatim: "Everything must be accounted for"
rows.proof: foyer-valid: a stale blob fails

rows.error: A proposal wrote the clean-slate rule as a gate that fails the boot when a memory file is seen.
rows.root_cause: An instruction was turned into a gate. Memory is a Vault, and the harness injects memory before any gate can run.
rows.source: Founder, verbatim: "clean slate was to get al agents the same snapshot to start from"
rows.proof: memory-guard: an intentional read after JEV routing is never a failure
rows.superseded: 2026-10-07, for the boot path only. PROTOCOL.md Article 2.3, verbatim: "Refuse to load any memory file in the boot path. A memory file in the boot path is a FLAG, not proof." Founder, verbatim: "Fix approved". Outside the boot path the 2026-10-06 ruling stands: a read after the JEV map has routed is never a failure, and Vault 2 Memory is its home.

rows.error: Agents started from different snapshots of the repo.
rows.root_cause: No single fingerprint of the pinned snapshot was printed or compared at boot.
rows.source: Founder, verbatim: "After the jev scan you will have context and read from the start"
rows.proof: snapshot-fingerprint: a checkout that differs from the pinned snapshot fails

rows.error: The check was wired into /start as doctor:boot while the queue was still [OPEN], so /start printed BLOCKED and gave no product tools to any 7.2 session.
rows.root_cause: A named open item was wired into a harness that treats any exit 1 as a lockout.
rows.source: start.mjs output on merged main: "/START BLOCKED - repo boot check failed; no product tools"
rows.proof: single-queue: doctor:boot wired while the queue is OPEN fails

rows.error: Filing the ROADMAP in Row 5.14 Build Plan made the check count that Row's Cabinet file as a second queue, because the file is named after the Row.
rows.root_cause: The queue-name rule tested every document name, and a Cabinet is named after its Row.
rows.source: single-queue output on the filing build: "2 queue files, one is allowed" naming ROADMAP.md and Cabinet-Build-Plan.md
rows.proof: single-queue: a Cabinet named after the queue's Row is not a second queue, but card lines in it are

rows.error: A handover whose slug names the ROADMAP was counted as a second queue.
rows.root_cause: The queue-name rule tested every document name, and a handover is named for what the session did.
rows.source: single-queue output on the close-doctor build: "2 queue files, one is allowed" naming the handover and ROADMAP.md
rows.proof: single-queue: a handover named after the queue is not a second queue, but card lines in it are

rows.error: The Foyer, which every agent opens, did not name the OS Page, so an agent could start at the Foyer and never read the OS.
rows.root_cause: The OS is Vault 1, reached through the Foyer, and nothing in the Foyer said to read the OS Page before it.
rows.source: Founder, verbatim: "all must read os"
rows.proof: foyer-valid: a Foyer that does not name the OS start Page fails

rows.error: single-routing-source's third-routing-table-by-content heuristic flagged a founder-dictation memory file (filed into Vault 2 Row 2.1) as a second routing table, because its prose names several Vaults next to their numbers while quoting a past Foyer summary.
rows.root_cause: The heuristic cannot tell a genuine second routing table apart from prose that merely quotes the Foyer's own Vault numbers inside a founder ruling.
rows.source: Founder, verbatim, relayed mid-build: "we are not blindly moving over everything must be verified before we enter" — the file was checked and is accurate; the variance is genuine, so it gets a named, explicit exception rather than a weakened gate.
rows.proof: single-routing-source: X-007 exempts a named founder-dictation file from the by-content heuristic

rows.error: loaded 7.1 punch list
rows.rule: no 7.1 source in the boot reading path
rows.root_cause: The boot card named one task list for every repo (row E-20261006-frozen-task-list-loaded).
rows.source: GUIDE.md, THE SELF-IMPROVING LOOP, "First three ERRATA rows to add now". Founder, verbatim: "why did you load 7.1 punchlist if we work in 7.2"
rows.proof: no-71-source: a registry that makes glumira-7.1 the active repo fails

rows.error: created duplicate task names
rows.rule: no task name appears in more than one source
rows.root_cause: Not stated in the Guide. Nothing compared the task names of the one queue with task lines elsewhere.
rows.source: GUIDE.md, THE SELF-IMPROVING LOOP, "First three ERRATA rows to add now"
rows.proof: single-queue: a task name of the queue in a second source fails

rows.error: memory injected at boot
rows.rule: no memory file in the boot path
rows.root_cause: Not stated in the Guide. Nothing listed the boot reading path, so a memory file could sit on it unseen.
rows.source: GUIDE.md, THE SELF-IMPROVING LOOP, "First three ERRATA rows to add now"
rows.proof: memory-guard: a memory file in the boot reading path fails

rows.error: File names carried the edition (72, 7.2, -v0, -v1.0), and no file said whether it was DONE.
rows.rule: A name carries the subject only, never the edition. Every Page file carries the stamp: edition, status (DONE or Mid Flight), date.
rows.root_cause: Names were made per edition, and nothing marked a file's state inside the file.
rows.source: Founder 2026-10-07, verbatim: "we must please get rid of this 72 iin the file names and mke a clean start for 7.2 that we can recognize all files as DONE in 7.2". PROTOCOL.md Article 6.5, verbatim: "The name travels. Only the edition line changes."
rows.proof: edition-stamp: a name with the edition and a Page file with no stamp fail

rows.error: Filing the Modules Vault made the read-only Builder document in Row 5.13 read as a third routing table (its table row "18 | Modules tab").
rows.root_cause: The content scan of single-routing-source read Row 5.13, which X-004 already exempts from names and stamps.
rows.source: Founder 2026-10-08, verbatim: "The vault will be Engines / Each engine a row and then breaks down, up to page level / This rule applies to all filing".
rows.proof: single-routing-source: read-only Row 5.13 text is never a routing table (X-004)

rows.error: Writing the 16 product Vaults into the JEV map made a Cabinet that reports function counts ("720 under USER DATA INFO, 560 under Engines", "Engines 560, Modules 125") read as a third routing table.
rows.root_cause: The content scan counted any digit beside a Vault name, so a count looked like a Vault number.
rows.source: Founder 2026-10-09, verbatim: "Everything sorted in main groups related to function"; picked "Approve the 16 Vaults (Recommended)".
rows.proof: single-routing-source: counts beside Vault names are not a routing table

rows.error: With 22 Vaults, the build-plan cards table ("Modules | 18", a card count) and the trace matrix (hex ids ending in a digit, "...ab7 | Engines > IOB Hunter") read as routing tables.
rows.root_cause: A hit counted any Vault number beside a name, including digits at the end of an id, not that Vault's own number as a standalone token.
rows.source: Founder 2026-10-09, verbatim: "I want to create a build plan to the fullest extent"; picked "Approve the 16 Vaults (Recommended)".
rows.proof: single-routing-source: a small count beside a Vault name is not that Vault's route

rows.error: The edition line was a number, so every new Page added a version number, and every Foyer change raised a version counter.
rows.rule: The edition line names the edition in a word, never a number. A Page unchanged since the edition change keeps its old line; every Page added or edited after it carries the new one. The Foyer counter is frozen.
rows.root_cause: Article 6.5 made a change of edition a copy that only changes the edition line, and STOP step 4 raised the Foyer version on every Cabinet change.
rows.source:
Founder 2026-10-10, verbatim: "The official launch name is Glumira
Do not add any version numbers in the 7.2 documents - that is only for you to keep track" and "I want to launch with everything in 1 repo / it becomes the Original launch version". Founder pick 2026-10-11, verbatim: "Original (Recommended)". The old Article 6.5 is archived word for word in Row 3.1, Book-Edition-Copy-Rule.
rows.proof: edition-stamp: a new Page with the past edition fails, an unchanged one passes

rows.error: Filing the approved Six Libraries spar plan word for word made it read as a third routing table: its tables name seven of today's Vaults next to their numbers to say where each one lands.
rows.root_cause: The by-content heuristic cannot tell a document of record that describes the Vault table from a second routing table, and the plan may not be reworded (never paraphrase).
rows.source: Founder pick 2026-10-11, verbatim: "Approve (Recommended)". ROADMAP card 08-01: "Then file the winning spar plan as a Page in this Row."
rows.proof: single-routing-source: X-009 exempts the filed Six Libraries plan from the by-content heuristic

rows.error: The edition-name test read the number of a Row folder (7.2-What-If, 17.2-Learning-Suite-Lessons) as the edition 7.2, so the first Page filed in either Row would fail.
rows.root_cause: The test looked for 7.2 anywhere in a name and did not take off the Vault or Row number that starts a Vault or Row folder.
rows.source: Six Libraries plan (Row 5.14, Book-Six-Libraries-Plan), founder pick 2026-10-11, verbatim: "Approve (Recommended)". Plan, function table: "Fix a bug that is live today. /72|7\.2|-v0|-v1\.0/ matches Row folders 7.2-What-If and 17.2-Learning-Suite-Lessons".
rows.proof: edition-stamp: a Vault or Row number is not an edition

rows.error: The subject "Production Builder" had two records, one routing to Vault 5 and one to Row 5.13, so one name sat on two levels.
rows.root_cause: jevErrors let a Vault record and a Row record of the same Vault share a subject.
rows.source: Six Libraries plan (Row 5.14, Book-Six-Libraries-Plan), founder pick 2026-10-11, verbatim: "Approve (Recommended)". Plan, question 2: "One subject, one record. ... Row 5.13's subject becomes \"Builder App\"."
rows.proof: single-routing-source: one subject, one record

rows.error: Nothing would notice a live file, a program or an open card that still names a folder after the folder moved, so a move could leave tools broken while every gate passed.
rows.root_cause: The check had no list of retired path prefixes and no reader of live text outside the Vault scans.
rows.source: Six Libraries plan (Row 5.14, Book-Six-Libraries-Plan), founder pick 2026-10-11, verbatim: "Approve (Recommended)". Plan, question 5, "The moved-prefix rule, defined exactly": "Its ERRATA row is \"a live file names a moved path\"."
rows.proof: foyer-valid: a live file or an open card that names a moved path fails

rows.error: The Vault 5 folder carried the brand and the edition (5-GluMira-7.2-Production-Builder), and Book and Page names repeated their Row, so paths grew long enough to need a named exception (X-005) and to press on the Windows path limit.
rows.root_cause: No gate measured path length, so a long name could be added, or grow back after a rename, with every gate passing.
rows.source: Founder order 2026-10-13, verbatim: "fix", given to: "Rename Vault 5 to `5-Production-Builder`, remove exception X-005, and add a path-length gate to CHECK.mjs so this cannot grow back." Then, verbatim: "do same for all vaults".
rows.proof: path-length: a tracked path longer than the limit fails

rows.error: A Page stamped with the past edition, unchanged since the edition change, failed edition-stamp once its folder was renamed, because the gate looked for its blob only at its new path.
rows.root_cause: pastEditionOk read the edition-change commit at the file's current path and never followed the JEV moved list back to the path it had then.
rows.source: Founder order 2026-10-13, verbatim: "fix" (the Vault 5 rename), and the Six Libraries plan's moved list, which records every renamed path.
rows.proof: edition-stamp: a moved Page unchanged since the edition change keeps its past edition
